methodology.event_score: 50 + signed signal strength*10, aggregate capped to +/-5 strength units
methodology.market_score: 50 plus deterministic signs of 20d return, MA20 distance, 20d relative strength, 5d return and high-volume 1d confirmation
methodology.composite: 60% event + 40% market when a fresh mapped event exists; otherwise market score only
methodology.conviction: distance of composite from neutral, scaled 0-100; market-only conviction capped at 55
methodology.status: research state only; no position sizing or trade instruction
